index_text: Hi, I'm Francisco Arocas, a Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience, currently living and working in Tenerife.
about_text1: Hi, I'm Francisco Arocas, a Software Engineer from the University of La Laguna, currently living in Santa Cruz de Tenerife, Canary Islands, Spain.
about_text2: I mainly work with Python and data engineering, although I have also built APIs, pipelines and full web applications.
about_text3: I have also worked with frameworks and technologies such as Django, React, Next.js, Docker and AWS.
fund360_p1: I work as a Backend Engineer building APIs and data pipelines for a financial analytics platform.
fund360_l1_i1: Built Django REST APIs for NAV calculations, portfolio performance and reporting.
fund360_l1_i2: Deployed services on AWS using EC2, Docker, RDS and Route 53.
fund360_l1_i3: Created CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, including tests, Docker image generation and auto-deploy.
fund360_l1_i4: Orchestrated Celery pipelines and processed data with Pandas, NumPy and Polars.
fund360_l1_i5: Improved performance and generated Excel and PDF reports with WeasyPrint.
gtc_p1: I designed and built a full data reduction pipeline to process hundreds of GB of astronomical images obtained by the telescope.
gtc_l1_i1: Implemented core algorithms in C/C++ and Python for bias/dark subtraction, flat-fielding and astrometric calibration.
gtc_l1_i2: Used NumPy, Pandas and Astropy for scientific processing and pipeline performance improvements.
gtc_l1_i3: Worked with Linux servers and Docker to package and deploy the pipeline containers.
gtc_l1_i4: Collaborated with the astrophysics team to improve data quality and results.
ull_p1: Research project: "Smart ports and electrification of internal traffic in the Canary Islands ports".
ull_l1_i1: Developed a LoRaWAN-based IoT infrastructure to monitor traffic.
ull_l1_i2: Processed sensor data with Raspberry Pi, Python and C++, and built real-time pipelines with MQTT.
ull_l1_i3: Managed storage and monitoring with InfluxDB, MySQL and Grafana.
ull_l1_i4: Built web interfaces with React and Next.js, and deployed services with Docker on Linux virtual machines.
fred_p1: I worked on processing and visualising maritime telemetry data from multiple vessels.
fred_l1_i1: Processed and cleaned data with Python, Pandas, NumPy and Folium.
fred_l1_i2: Built a FastAPI backend and a React frontend for geospatial visualisation and metrics.
fred_l1_i3: Integrated Leaflet and Bootstrap for interactive maps and responsive design.
fred_l1_i4: Visualised more than 10 vessels and hundreds of thousands of positioning data points.
fred_p2: Through a scholarship granted by the General Foundation of the University of La Laguna.
cab_p1: I developed a full-stack application for processing and visualising vehicle traffic data.
cab_l1_i1: Built the backend with Django to process, transform and store large volumes of data.
cab_l1_i2: Built a responsive frontend with React, JavaScript and Bootstrap for analytics dashboards.
cab_l1_i3: The platform was used internally to support traffic analysis and urban planning.
